question: List out the no. of districts that have female average salary is more than 6000 but less than 10000?
evidence: A11 refers to average salary; Female mapps to gender = 'F'
clarification: Count every row, including repeated district_id values.
gold: SELECT COUNT(T2.district_id) FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE T1.gender = 'F' AND T2.A11 BETWEEN 6000 AND 10000
gold0: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.district_id)  FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE T1.gender = 'F' AND T2.A11 BETWEEN 6000 AND 10000

d.request: How many district rows have an average salary (A11) greater than 6000 and less than 10000 for females (gender = 'F'), counting repeated district_id values separately?
d.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM district AS d JOIN client AS c ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND d.A11 > 6000 AND d.A11 < 10000

b.request: Count female clients (gender = 'F') whose district has an A11 average salary greater than 6000 and less than 10000, counting every client row even when district_id repeats
b.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client AS c JOIN district AS d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND d.A11 > 6000 AND d.A11 < 10000
